processing: Original transparent PNGs retained. Sharp trim of transparent margins (background #00000000, threshold 10), contain-resize to 464×464 with transparent background, 24px transparent padding on each side for a 512×512 final image. WebP quality 88 and alphaQuality 100. Text and interactions stay in HTML.
